entities.name: Seongjong of Joseon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Seongjong, personal name Yi Hyeol, was the ninth monarch of the Joseon dynasty of Korea. Before succeeding his sickly uncle, King Yejong, he was known as Grand Prince Jalsan.
